regions.merged_text: everything possible that the soul can desire. He offers Himself to us and all in His Almighty power on one con- dition that we accept His offer; that we show a good will and hearken to His word and follow Him. The holy gospel just read reecoes again and again and emphasises this holy doctrine: - Emphasizes the fact that if we want to find peace and save our souls we have no alternative but to espouse the cause of Jesus Christ - whenever and wherever and however we may. - He that is not with me is against me and he that gathereth not with me scattereth." -- "Yea blessed are they who hear the word of God and keep it," Self-understood on the contrary, unfortunate .. they who hear not the word of God and keep it not. We hear much these days about the power of the press and of the importance of good reading. Indeed it is im- possible that any of us fully understand or realize either of these - either the power of the press for good or for evil; or the importance of good reading to counteract the evil press and bad reading. The devil surely does understand both pretty well. He realizes the power of the press for he has many agents in this world with the press at their command, whose hearts are corrupted-whose souls are sadly in his power. But --- Therefore the admonition of P. Pius X of Bl. M. "You may establish schools and build churches; all will be in vain unless you have a strong active Cath. press - aggressive as well as defensive. Therefore also the zeal of the clergy to procure good literature and therefore again the duty of every one of us to support the Cath. press, to procure and to read and spread good reading - our duty to be with Jesus Christ in this regard and not against Him, to gather with Him and not to scatter; our duty and privilege to cherish the written word of God and not disregarding it. Amen.
